Interactive Knowledge Library

Curate your curiosities.

A living constellation of learning and collection of visual learning experiences built to help you explore knowledge by touching, tracing, comparing, dissecting, rebuilding, and testing what you learn not just by reading. You explore it.

THE NODES KNOW.

Touch a node to understand how subjects and fields intersect across the collection.

The Impossible Museum on the internet.

Built to be touched.

Maps reveal relationships. Objects let you inspect structures. Laboratories let you take systems apart, rebuild them, compare them and follow processes in motion. Reconstruction separates evidence from inference.

Built from traceable sources.

Educational claims are linked to their references inside each experience. Evidence stays accessible without turning the library entrance into a bibliography.
